tagline: World's second-largest steel producer with committed decarbonization strategy
hero_kpi_rationale: Decarbonization capex reflects the company's genuine commitment to energy transformation, an existential issue for the steel sector facing the need to reduce its CO2 emissions from 114.3 MtCO2e annually.

kpis.name: Decarbonization Investments
kpis.explanation: Annual amount invested in decarbonization projects and technological transformation.
kpis.description: $500 million invested in 2021-2023 in decarbonization, representing 1/22nd of shareholder distributions.
kpis.signal: Investment significantly lower than shareholder distributions ($11 billion in 2021-23 vs. $500 million capex).

kpis.name: Carbon Footprint
kpis.explanation: Group's annual carbon footprint reported in tonnes of CO2 equivalent.
kpis.description: ArcelorMittal generated 114.3 MtCO2e in 2023, representing approximately 7% of annual global steel sector emissions.
kpis.signal: Carbon footprint equivalent to that of an entire European country.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees as of December 31 of the reported year.
kpis.description: 126,756 employees as of December 31, 2023 operating in 19 countries covering Europe, Americas, Africa and Asia.
kpis.signal: Stable and significant global workforce supporting geographically diversified operations.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Global revenue reported for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Global revenue of $68.3 billion in 2023, consolidating the position of world's second-largest steel producer.
kpis.signal: Major revenue reflecting leadership position in the global steel sector.

kpis.name: Steel Production
kpis.explanation: Total volume of steel produced annually.
kpis.description: Estimated steel production of 58 million tonnes in 2023 from 19 countries.
kpis.signal: Major production volume consolidating position as world's second-largest producer.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €97.7 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €13.41 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €5.39 billion in the latest year
